_note: Global generation (SGODOT-280, plan v2 §9.3.2 / §6.3.3 / §9.4.3). tiers, placement, tea_words, keeper_names, name_rules and wild are 李白's outposts.json (SGODOT-281, 47fafcea) as-is; seed, ponds, area_tier, coastal and room are the generator's own (后裔). Generated places are frozen by id (<cluster>~<kind><n>): a change here that moves an existing city must bump world.revision.

ponds._note: §6.3.3: 3 from a cluster's first 500,000 people, one more per 500,000 more, at most 6. Ponds 1–3 sit on the 2.5 km ring at 0° / 120° / 240° (rotated by the cluster's hash), 4–6 on the 5 km ring between them. Pond 1 (nearest the centre) is the beginner Pond; 2 River; 3 Coast for a coastal cluster, else River; 4–6 by hash, at least one Pond kept.

words._note: q(125): pond words by climate band, forty a band, 3–6 taken per city by hash and never twice in a city; a tackle shop takes its pond's word (`<word> Tackle Shop`). The bands share no word with each other, the tea house pools, the keeper names, the fish or any city name (server/data/cities.tsv). San Francisco keeps its hand-written names.

area_tier._note: Built-up area has no data source yet: the population tier is raised to these (q(114) ②, 李白 on 280 79c3ecbd; LA and Tokyo by the plan's §9.3.2 examples). Keyed by cluster id.

coastal._note: Coastline within 20 km of the centre (§6.3.3) and the residents' city traits (§9.4.3: coast, river, highland), by hand until there is geodata: the acceptance cities and q(114) ③'s list (London river, Denver highland, Honolulu and Tromsø coast). Any other cluster has none.

home._note: Choosing a home (SGODOT-303, q(160)–q(161)). cities: the open list beyond the written city (San Francisco is always open), the first step's hand-checked cities (temperate New York City, London, Tokyo; subtropical Los Angeles, Miami, Shanghai; tropical Singapore, Mexico City, Hong Kong; cool Stockholm, Copenhagen, Helsinki), each of M1 tier and up with a full home set; spot: 3 spots round the beginner pond, pond_km from it, apart_km between them, scatter_m per player (the 300 m from outposts and ponds is placement.farm_exclusion_m); change: one free change within days of the account or before Homestead before_level. Read by server/src/p0/home_city.ts.

overrides._note: q(114) ⑤: hand fixes by place id, laid over the generated city after everything else is placed, so nothing else in the city moves. A pin that landed in the sea or a lake gets a point on land at least 50 m from the water (a tackle shop within 300 m of its pond); before the freeze the same table takes a hand rename (`name`). `why`: what was wrong, who saw it, and the checks on the new point. Re-check the whole table once there is water data. Names in `why` are the ones the place had when it was found (q(125) later renamed generated ponds and their tackle shops; the id is what counts).
